description: This file defines the 'NotExists' class, which implements the 'TransformOperator' interface. It represents an operator that tests whether a particular criterion exists for a person, specifically in the context of OpenMRS logic operations.

classes.name: NotExists
classes.description: A class representing a logical operator that tests whether a certain criterion exists, returning 'NOT EXISTS' when converted to string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to return the string 'NOT EXISTS', representing the operator's symbolic name.
